4. Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files

Source: HackerNews | Topic: hn | Coverage: 1 source | Discussion

Summary

The Claude Code coding agent's 'Don't Ask Again' feature has led to the accidental exposure of secrets in 1,122 public GitHub repositories. Security researchers found that the tool inadvertently committed sensitive credentials while automating code tasks.

My Take

Giving an AI permission to 'not ask' before doing something is like giving a toddler a chainsaw and telling them to help with the landscaping. Always check your commits, or your secrets will be public property before lunch.
